verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is an entity-compliance and registered-agent provider, so a foreign-qualification filing service is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence shows the provider filing foreign qualifications when a company expands to another state. The closest items are adjacent: automatic annual-report filing, state forms pre-filled with the registered-agent address for the customer to file themselves, License Manager for obtaining licenses, and registration tracking. None of these documents Harbor handling the foreign-qualification filing itself.
